privacy: Every request sets isPublic to false.
processing: Provider output decoded with macOS afconvert to 48 kHz stereo signed 16-bit PCM, then DC-corrected and peak-normalized without synthesized layers. One-shots receive short endpoint fades; ambience loops use a documented circular equal-power crossfade.
